t: A smart little camera that finds colors and lines for your robot.
steps: Buy Pixy2 from Adafruit or SparkFun for about 75 US dollars.
Install the free PixyMon app on Windows, macOS or Linux.
Plug Pixy2 into your computer with a micro USB cable and open PixyMon.
Hold a bright object in front of the lens and press the button until the LED changes color.
Watch PixyMon draw a box around the object as you move it.
Install the Pixy2 Arduino library and connect Pixy2 to an Arduino with the supplied cable.
Run the ccc_hello_world example and read the object positions in the serial monitor.
meta: Open Board. From $74.95. A few stores.
